biotools.summary: Desktop application that runs RNA-seq differential expression analyses (Rsubread, DESeq2, clusterProfiler) from a public study, local FASTQ files or a count matrix, and certifies them: code, parameters, input data and their provenance, R environment and results are combined into a composite SHA-256 fingerprint published on the Base blockchain, optionally linked to the ORCID iD of the researcher. A PDF certificate and an RO-Crate allow anyone to verify the record and to re-run the analysis, with a graded verdict that distinguishes bit-for-bit reproduction, numerical noise between systems and real differences; only the fingerprint is published, and the data stay on the computer of the user.
